data.exact_reserve_text: 2022 is the YOA closing at this point with an NCOR of 96.6% which is 8.0pp above plan. As of 1 January 2025, the Syndicate has successfully externally Reinsured-to-Close the 2022 and prior underwriting years into Syndicate 3500, managed by Riverstone Managing Agency Limited. This crystalises the result for the Syndicate on these years providing certainty and therefore removes the risks associated with the market backdrop described above and no liabilities on the 2022 and prior underwriting years will be passed to the Syndicate's open underwriting years.

data.standardized_narrative: The report does not disclose a single explicit gross prioryear reserve movement figure. Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2024 per the balance sheet was 406.165 million (USD). The text highlights significant prioryear market stresses including Hurricane Ian, the outbreak of the Ukrainian War and high postCOVID inflationary impacts (notably on construction), and notes that the Syndicate externally ReinsuredtoClose the 2022 and prior years into another syndicate, thereby crystallising those years' results. No gross prioryear strengthening/release amount is provided in the technical notes; therefore the direction is recorded as mixed based on narrative references to both adverse developments (motor and construction) and the successful RITC closure.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (liabilities) at 31 Dec 2023 (presented as 'Claims outstanding' gross). No explicit gross prioryear movement (movement in prior year's provision) figure is disclosed in the notes; technical provisions note provides gross opening and closing balances and gross 'claims incurred during the year' but not an explicit 'prior year movement' gross figure. Claims development triangle or a 'movement in prior year provision' gross table was not available in the extracted text; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. Many named events are described qualitatively but no per-event gross reserve impacts are quantified. All monetary amounts are reported in the report's native currency (USD) and converted from thousands to millions.
